name: Turbo oil return line, IN625 F0 concept
description: Clean-sheet concept of a left line with an open internal passage and two integrated flanges. PorscheFanatics and Patrick Motorsports confirm the 993 Turbo functional need, but no dimension or material; the entire F0 route remains synthetic.

classification.intended_use: F0 screening of hollow CAD, hydraulics, pressure, bending, expansion, thermal and DfAM; no manufacturing, installation, oil circulation or engine start authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, Porsche/Patrick Motorsports/EOS surface or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - candidate turbo oil return line
sources.notes: Identifies the scavenge/return lines as a known weakness and catalogues the Patrick set, without geometry or material. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TURBO-OIL-RETURN-CANDIDATE.

sources.title: Patrick Motorsports - 993 turbo oil return line set
sources.notes: Confirms a left/right set, 993 Turbo 1996-1997, pump to tank, anti-backflow shape and mandatory final fitting; no dimension or material. See SRC-PATRICKMOTORSPORTS-993-TURBO-OIL-RETURN-PIPES.

sources.title: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 material data sheet
sources.notes: M 290 40 µm comparison values dependent on process and orientation. See SRC-EOS-IN625-MATERIAL-DATA.

sources.title: Special Metals - INCONEL alloy 625
sources.notes: Wrought thermal reference used only at F0, not equivalent to LPBF. See SRC-SPECIAL-METALS-INCONEL-625.

sources.title: 993 factory catalogue, plate 202-16 Turbocharger
sources.notes: Identifies four oil pipe references in two positions, three vent line, two oil collection container and two bracket on the same plate. Establishes neither the feed/return assignment, nor the dimensions, nor the material. See SRC-PET-993-202-16-TURBO-OIL-CIRCUIT.

material.family: heat- and corrosion-resistant nickel superalloy, LPBF candidate
material.grade: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 / UNS N06625 for comparison; commercial material unknown
material.standard: ASTM F3055, AMS 7000 or AMS 7001 and a program-specific line specification to be contracted

post_processing: orientation with no internal support and recoater strategy to be qualified
complete removal of external supports and proof of depowdering
stress relief and heat treatment qualified for the thin wall
HIP to be decided on defects, fatigue, leak-tightness and pressure results
machining of faces, bores, seats and datums after compensation
controlled internal finishing with no media or debris retention
engine-oil cleaning, passivation and cleanliness packaging
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, supports, lot and recycling
oriented thin coupons with tensile, fatigue, oxidation and hot oil compatibility
demonstrated capability on a 1.2 mm wall and a 10.3 mm passage with no internal support
full CT and borescope with criteria for defects, obstruction and residual powder
metrology of both routes, flanges, faces, spacings, clocking and vehicle clearances
proof of pressure, leakage, burst, flow, return, thermal cycling and vibration

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Qualify IN625 against case, turbo, fasteners, gaskets and oil; address fretting, corrosion, oxidation and differential expansion.

known_limits: The name of this record says "return"; plate 202-16 does not establish it. It carries four `oil pipe` references in two positions, without distinguishing feed from return. The attribution remains to be done.
The sources confirm only the function, the left/right set, 1996-1997 and the final fitting; no dimension is published.
The F0 left line, its spline, diameters, wall and flanges are entirely synthetic; the right side is absent.
The theoretical mass depends on the F0 volume and the IN625 density, with no comparison with the commercial part.
The flows, pressure, temperature, viscosity, minor losses, load and supports are regression inputs.
Single-phase hydraulics does not represent aerated oil, two-phase drainage, pulsations or the scavenge pump.
The fully constrained thermal screen fails; the actual compliance and engine-turbo movements are unknown.
The final-fitting need stated by the supplier is incompatible with a rigid LPBF tube without vehicle metrology.
The STEP proves only a readable hollow BREP and is authorized neither for manufacturing, nor oil, nor turbo or engine use.
The circuit counts eleven fluid or retention parts on the same plate: that is where the additive gain lies, and it is not investigated.

The fittings of an oil line are removed in service. The TITANIUM.md grid explicitly excludes titanium on repeated threading exposed to galling: even without the fire question, this is not a titanium part.
